progress_summary: Short Pick Lab historical replay now compares LLM direct picking, legacy LLM self/momentum-pool distillation, momentum-volume controls, expanded momentum pools, broad/strict veto designs, deterministic sealed-market feature rerankers, and broader market-only factor studies. The accepted default candidate remains `momentum_10d_turnover_cooldown_rank` / `ret10_turnover_cooldown`, scoring Top40 momentum-volume candidates by rank_percentile(return_10d) + rank_percentile(turnover_rate) - 0.5*rank_percentile(return_1d). Earlier mixed-permission studies showed encouraging lab results, but those results are no longer treated as executable proof for the user's new retail cash account because visible samples included 创业板/科创板 candidates. The executable account profile is now `new_retail_cash_account`: 沪深主板普通A股 only, excluding 科创板、创业板、北交所、ST/退市风险类标的. A Tushare main-board reconstruction sampled 180 eligible stocks, covering 2023-05-16 through 2026-04-27 and 715 signal days. Under that executable universe, the previously frozen stop-loss main line `ret10_turnover_second_market_positive_cooldown_stop8` fails revalidation: 221 trades, total return -44.7%, universe-equal-weight excess -81.2%, max drawdown -63.7%. The no-stop second-candidate variant is less bad but still not production-grade: total return +46.9%, excess +10.5%, max drawdown -62.2%. Therefore the current reliable interpretation is: keep paper tracking and controls running for forward evidence, but mark the old frozen stop-loss strategy as account-executability revalidation failed and do not present the old +62.6% mixed-permission excess as an executable expected return. The live selection path now filters future shortpick market-factor candidates by the new retail account profile; simulation/manual orders enforce account eligibility, T+1 sell availability, board lot/quantity rules, price-limit checks, one-price limit-up/down blocks, and the current 0.05% sell stamp tax. The 2026-05-11 scheduled-refresh incident is closed: the LaunchAgent bootstrap gap, AKShare/announcement subprocess hangs, shortpick validation catchup blocking, DB-lock wait, timeout process-tree cleanup, and DeepSeek shortpick per-round soft timeout are all deployed to runtime. Live 2026-05-11 postmarket analysis and Short Pick Lab completed, and the full non-skip-simulation Phase5 refresh generated a new model simulation session holding 600589.SH 3000 shares. 2026-05-14 Short Pick Lab historical replay decision readout Phase 1, Phase 2/3 evidence projection surface, follow-up market-stage plus industry/theme evidence tables, and long-window deterministic strategy slice evidence are published and browser-verified on localhost plus authenticated canonical route. tail_capture_fillable_linear_replay.finding: Naive per-date binary tail-capture labels over the full fillable universe inverted the concentrated Top3 signal.
